metadata.description: Fails the run naming every line of a Rust file under engine/crates that points at a made-up absolute path such as "/nonexistent": on Windows that is C:\nonexistent, which can exist (gotchas.md). Run it from the repo root.

parameters.script:
# nonexistent-paths: fail naming every line of an engine Rust file that
# points at a made-up absolute path such as "/nonexistent". On Windows that is
# C:\nonexistent, which can exist (gotchas.md, Windows Portability): use a
# path under a temp dir instead. Each argument is one file, relative to
# engine/crates.
# Gap: a content-search node will replace this step (dogfooding.md, PR 9).
cd engine/crates || exit 2
found=$(grep -HniE '"/[^"]*nonexistent' -- "$@")
case $? in
  0) ;;
  1) echo "No engine Rust file points at a made-up absolute path."; exit 0 ;;
  *) exit 2 ;;
esac
echo "Made-up absolute paths (use a path under a temp dir; see gotchas.md):" >&2
printf '%s\n' "$found" | sed 's|^|  engine/crates/|' >&2
exit 1
